result:
Decisive mistake: the task needed only a public, unauthenticated API call (the revisions list works without a token, or the page history/"info" tool gives counts). The plan chose a token path. At Step 5, Verification_Expert re-issued the same code with the placeholder 'YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN' and told the team to replace it, so it failed again with an invalid-token error. It also never fixed the pagination bug, where the loop would not advance via rvcontinue, and it never dropped the pointless auth header. That step wasted the attempt and led the team off to a dead end, after which WebServing_Expert ended up summarizing the article instead of counting edits.

AGENT: Verification_Expert
STEP: 5
